items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional only for bounded internal/read-only work that preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, and data boundaries. Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private and preview-only. Evidence: Woot documentation establishes API access mechanics but not rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize returned data; current public terms restrict relevant uses. All four launch-readiness legal tasks remain open. Human counsel is required before any rights-dependent launch, affiliate/advertising use, or external rights request. Fleet compliance is a technical baseline, not certification: 36 pass, 17 fail, 6 unknown. Do not block ordinary reversible growth solely for incomplete telemetry, but do not permit public exposure or security-sensitive release while material gates remain incomplete. Revenue evidence is limited to $4.92 aggregate Amazon commission for 2026-09-21 and is not site-attributable; no ROI or causal claim is supported.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Progress is evidenced by official Woot API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts, but no task meets its closure deliverable. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization.

Concrete launch decision: keep complicated.work parked, private, and preview-only. Complete the existing readiness packet by 2026-09-30T17:00:00Z with dated ownership, preview/build evidence, compliance baseline, security unknowns, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker evidence. No publish, deploy, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spend, dependency addition, or queue entry is authorized.
